engine: 11tanjung's WHERE beat — a hand-authored, MONOCHROME line-art district map: thin (~1px) cream strokes on a brown field (NO Google / NO Mapbox, NO fills, NO colour). Inline SVG roads draw in (stroke-dashoffset), a target-marker (ringed dot / crosshair) marks the project, and POI labels connected by LEADER-LINES fade + rise in with a bottom-to-top STAGGER on scroll-into-view. Harvested from D_11tanjung (D2). VARIANT .lam--street (finest look, D_finest F5): the SAME engine on a light theme — thin SAGE strokes on warm PAPER, optional vineyard HATCHING + park/water area fills, a LABEL-PILL project marker (.lam-pin, e.g. 'finest') instead of the crosshair, and named POI pins with icon glyphs. One engine, two looks (brown line / light street).

measured_teardown.move: on scroll-into-view a progress p 0..1 drives: (1) the road paths [data-draw] draw via stroke-dashoffset (full length -> 0) over the first 55%, power2.out; (2) the target-marker [data-target] fades + scales 0.7->1 over 0.30..0.62; (3) the POIs [data-poi] (each = a leader-line + a dot + a label) ladder up over 0.45..1, each in its own window, sorted BOTTOM-to-TOP (the lowest on screen reveals first): opacity 0->1 + translateY 14px->0, with the leader-line growing scaleY 0->1 from its anchored bottom. set(p) is a PURE scrub. NB: the target's SVG translate lives on an OUTER <g>; JS scales only an INNER [data-target] <g> so the position is preserved (a CSS transform on the positioned group would wipe the translate).
measured_teardown.cited: 11tanjung D2: a vector line-art map (thin ~1px cream stroke on brown, NOT Google/Mapbox): inline-SVG roads + a target-marker of the project + POIs with leader-lines, appearing with a bottom-to-top stagger on reveal. GSAP stagger opacity/y on ScrollTrigger.

draw.what: draw the road strokes via stroke-dashoffset on reveal; false = roads already present, only the target + POIs animate.

stagger.what: spacing between POIs in the bottom-to-top ladder (added to the reveal timeline length).

duration.what: base reveal duration (the road-draw + target); total = duration + stagger*POIcount.

ease.what: the reveal curve (applied per channel: draw, target, each POI window).

start.what: ScrollTrigger start — when the section is far enough into view to play.

once.what: play the reveal once (true) or replay on re-enter / reset on leave-back (false).

manageLenis.what: if true and Lenis is present, the component owns a Lenis instance + ticker; set false when the page already drives a shared Lenis (lab sets false).

entry: LineArtLocationMap.create(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, set(p), play(), refresh(), destroy }. target = .lam-stage holding an inline <svg class='lam-map'> ([data-draw] road paths + an OUTER <g translate> wrapping an INNER <g data-target>) and DOM .lam-poi[data-poi] elements (each: .lam-leader + .lam-dot + .lam-label) positioned by left/top. set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub of the whole reveal.
law: stroke-dashoffset (road draw) + transform (translateY on POIs, scale on the target, scaleY on leader-lines) + opacity only; GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop; NO WebGL; reduced-motion or <=820px -> shown (map fully revealed, no play). owns_pin false (a scroll-into-view reveal, not a pin). GSAP + ScrollTrigger required for the scroll path; set(p) works standalone. The map art + POI positions are COMPOSITION (hand-authored inline SVG + positioned DOM), the engine drives the reveal.
gate_mode: scroll-into-view reveal (triggered timeline, not a pin). Verify: roads draw (dashoffset -> 0) over the first ~55%; target fades + scales in AT ITS MAP POSITION (not the corner — the outer translate must survive); POIs ladder bottom-to-top with leader-lines growing scaleY 0->1. GATE-BLINDSPOT: SVG/stroke media -> a naive blank% probe under-reads; verify the dashoffset + opacity curve + fps/jank. Smoothness via the scroll-into-view path (arm the meter, scroll the section in).
proven: lab: a hand-authored brown line-art district map (3 main + 3 minor roads, a centre target ⊙, 4 POIs). Curve measured live (p / road0-dashoffset / target-opacity / POI-opacities bottom-to-top): 0 / 1513 / 0 / [0,0,0,0] -> 0.30 / 313 / 0 / [0,0,0,0] -> 0.55 / 0 / 0.95 / [0.70,0,0,0] -> 0.70 / 0 / 1 / [1,0.81,0,0] -> 0.85 / 0 / 1 / [1,1,0.90,0.21] -> 1 / 0 / 1 / [1,1,1,0.96]. Leader-line scaleY 0 -> 0.70 -> 1. Roads draw by p=0.55, the target fades in over 0.30..0.62 AT CENTRE (676,418 in a 1280x800 viewport = the map middle, not the corner), the POIs ladder bottom-to-top. Probe (4x CPU throttle, scrolled into view): 1/353 long frames (0.3%), 59.9fps -> PASS. Zero console errors. Distinct from Springs watercolor-svg-map (cream colour-blob map that rises then pins) — this is flat monochrome line-art with leader-line POIs.
